column1: # Sailing mooring points. Generated by scripts/sailing/docks.py from the OSRS wiki's Mooring point
# list (map pins) and the bundled collision map: Dock is the walkable land tile at the gangplank,
# Mooring the nearest water tile, which the collision map keeps separate from the land. Port id is the
# game's dock id, the value of a boat's SAILING_BOAT_n_PORT varbit while it's moored there.
